text:
Nadia (Docs): I started a tiny PR to add an "Optimize toolkit" microguide focused on practical batching/caching/quant tips. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1012 (WIP)
Vik R.: nice. can the guide include a one-step migration map for teams on legacy quant names + a few short copy-paste SDK snippets? engineers want the smallest runnable example.
Nadia (Docs): yes  adding per-route examples for Node and Python, a short decision flow, and a YAML mapping section. keeping it intentionally short.
Marta (Platform): please include a short note on when KV prefetch helps vs when it increases memory pressure (e.g., very large prefix caches + small GPU memory).
Nadia (Docs): good call. I'll add a single-sentence tradeoff and a pointer to the Optimize console charts for memory/kv hit-rate.
style-bot: lint: prefer imperative present-tense. Replace "we will"/"we'll" with "Enable"/"Use" phrasing.
Nadia (Docs): fixed tone. pasting final snippets for quick review: 
```
// Node (per-route) - enable batching + prefix KV prefetch
import {RedwoodClient} from '@redwood/inference-node';
const client = new RedwoodClient({apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY});

await client.createRoute('summarize', {
  model: 'open-llama-13b-v2',
  batching: {maxTokensPerBatch: 800, maxBatchSize: 5, timeoutMs: 10},
  kv_prefetch: {enabled: true, ttlSeconds: 240}
});
```
```
# Python (per-route) - batching + kv prefetch
from redwood.inference import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
client.create_route('answers', config={
  'model': 'open-llama-13b-v2',
  'batching': {'max_tokens_per_batch': 800, 'max_batch_size': 5, 'timeout_ms': 10},
  'kv_prefetch': {'enabled': True, 'ttl_seconds': 240}
})
```
Nadia (Docs): and the migration map YAML (inline):
```
# quant-mapping.yml
old_profile_a: q4_0  # run evals, q4_0 is cost-saving but may lower fidelity on perplexity-sensitive tasks
old_profile_b: q8_0  # recommended for instruction-heavy or safety-sensitive flows
```
Vik R.: can you add a one-line benchmark? bench-bot told me a quick local run: q4_0 @ batch=5 median token-latency 35ms, q8_0 @ batch=5 median 52ms; cost delta roughly -28% for q4_0.
Nadia (Docs): added the sentence with the bench numbers and linked the gist. also added a short "When not to batch aggressively" checklist: sub-100ms SLOs, multi-turn stateful agents, and token-by-token deterministic generation.
Marta (Platform): add a line noting kv_prefetch TTL tradeoff: longer TTL improves reuse but increases RAM for stored kv entries.
Nadia (Docs): done. small CI note: linkcheck failed on an old model alias I missed. updated references from open-llama-13b -> open-llama-13b-v2 and replaced any legacy package names with @redwood/inference-node and redwood.inference.
release-bot: ci/docs-linkcheck passed on head of PR #1012 after fixes.
Vik R.: quick nit: prefer timeoutMs=10 across snippets to match runtime default.
Nadia (Docs): updated snippets to 10ms and switched one phrasing per style-bot guidance. tagging for final merge; @Marta please give final approve on the platform caveats. thanks! :white_check_mark:
